reply_text:
Moss's 30 September digest lists Mateo's Door 14 ticket as #8841. It's the Vantorre Group (VTG) support ticket. The issue is that second-shift drivers at Newark can't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. You escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check the number before you send it to engineering. A 1 July message of yours in #strategic-pod also uses #8841, for a different matter: the Detention Summary export, which you said you closed out. The digest may have reused that number by mistake. The digest is the only place I found the Door 14 ticket, so I can't confirm which is right. Look #8841 up in the support system if you can.
